title: 第三百九十九章 林奇第三百九十八章 火龙
slug: 开局a级禁物玩家给我打工
content_zh:
第三百九十九章【林奇】
命运序列整个序列的能力都围绕着一个点展开。
那就是干扰，或者说...影响。
大多数命运序列的超凡者战斗方式都遵循一个逻辑。
他们会学习某种【技艺】或者使用某种【禁物】，在战斗时用命运序列的超凡之力干扰敌人并用【技艺】或【禁物】对敌人进行致命一击。
想要通过命运直接将敌人弄死是很难的。
除非两者的等级差过大。
比如...原本【聪慧】的伊萨里斯。
如果林奇不曾穿越，阿波罗公司不曾干扰AI...
那么伊萨里斯本人原本的命运轨迹便是成为一名序列9的牵线人，作为主角伊莱娜前期的天使投资人成为吻痕镇的官方一号人物。
他会拥有着足够的财富和地位并且身边有着卡夫这个序列6的护卫。
在吻痕镇...或者说在整个维里迪亚都很安全。
向上他是国家一号领导人伊莱娜的天使投资人，向下身边有着能够叫出名号的序列6强者护卫，自身有钱有地位。
妥妥的人生赢家。
关于【聪慧】的伊萨里斯在【吻痕镇】之后会如何这一点没人会知道。
因为在公司内部测试时AI刚刚把主线推进到吻痕镇篇章结束就被紧急暂停了。
然后...就是【愚蠢】的伊萨里斯。
他的未来更加清晰，普通人，爱吹牛，爱喝酒，瘟疫爆发的时候死掉。
那么究竟是里昂·洛佩斯这个父亲放弃了【愚蠢】的伊萨里斯，认为他没有任何培养价值所以就放任他死掉了。
还是说...他是在某个命运序列的高序列干扰下死掉的呢？

尽管林奇和里昂接触不多，但他感觉里昂并不是那种冷漠的父亲。
作为浪漫序列的高序列者他的内心对于亲情绝对不会漠视。
命运序列就是这样，相比起正面硬碰硬跟你真刀真枪干一架的【战争序列】，他们更喜欢躲在暗处偷偷的放冷箭。
拉明也是如此。
他学会了杰克·森特的【技艺】阿尔格斯近身术，有着【黑刃】这个【B级禁物】和【银甲】这个【C级】防御型禁物。
他应该在暗处偷偷的拨动林奇的命运让他死在某个意外之中。
但他做不到，甚至他的老师都做不到。
明明身为命运序列却影响不了敌人的未来。
让命运序列的超凡者和其他超凡者面对面1V1，就相当于让瞎子去开车、哑巴去演讲、聋子去听歌、瘸子去跑腿......
尽管拉明是命运序列：序列5因果窃贼，但他的正面战斗力完全不如林奇。
林奇看着拉明狼狈的模样内心有些疑惑。
他的老师派他来的目的是什么？
如果对方真的对自己了如指掌的话肯定知道单单凭拉明一个人是完全打不过自己的。
别看拉明的序列高出卡夫一个等级，两人的正面搏杀能力却完全不同。
一人是从小被当做【无常秘偶会】的暗杀机器培养，经过各种战斗的淬炼，又在后期跟随着里昂这个序列3学过不少东西的卡夫。
一人是战斗经验极少、正面搏杀能力很差、只会在暗处偷偷写东西恶心人的拉明...
林奇没有搞懂对方的意图。
师傅你究竟是干什么的？
就你这正面搏杀的能力还敢出现在我的面前？
第三百九十九章【林奇】

我一肘给你怼飞！
“你的目的是什么？在正面杀掉我？”想不通的林奇干脆问了出来，甚至在问的时候他的枪口依然指向拉明。
站起身的拉明听到林奇说的话气笑了。
content_en:
Chapter 399 [Lynch]
The abilities of the entire sequence of destiny revolve around one point.
That's interference, or...influence.
The way most superhumans fight in Destiny Sequences follows a logic.
They will learn a certain [skill] or use a certain [forbidden object], use the extraordinary power of the fate sequence to interfere with the enemy during battle, and use [skill] or [forbidden object] to deliver a fatal blow to the enemy.
It is difficult to kill an enemy directly through destiny.
Unless the level difference between the two is too large.
For example...the originally [intelligent] Isharis.
If Lynch had never traveled through time and Apollo had never interfered with AI...
Then Isalis's original destiny path was to become a Sequence 9 matchmaker. As the early angel investor of the protagonist Elena, he became the official number one figure in Hickey Town.
He will have enough wealth and status and have a guard of Sequence 6, Kraft, by his side.
It's safe in Hickey Town...or in all of Viridia.
Upward, he is the angel investor of the country's number one leader, Elena. Downward, he is surrounded by powerful Sequence 6 warriors who can be named. He is rich and status-savvy.
A sure winner in life.
No one knows what will happen to the wise Isharis after Hickey Town.
Because during the company's internal testing, AI had just advanced the main plot to the end of the Kiss Town chapter and was urgently suspended.
And then...there's the [stupid] Isharis.
His future is clearer, an ordinary person who loves bragging and drinking, and dies when the plague breaks out.
So it was Leon Lopez, the father, who gave up on the [stupid] Isharis, thinking that he had no value in cultivating him, so he let him die.
Or... did he die due to high-sequence interference in a certain destiny sequence?
Although Lynch didn't have much contact with Leon, he felt that Leon was not the kind of indifferent father.
As a high-sequence romantic person, he will never be indifferent to family affection in his heart.
The fate sequence is like this. Compared to the [War Sequence] where you fight head-on with real swords and guns, they prefer to hide in the dark and shoot cold arrows secretly.
So does Lamin.
He learned Jack Center's [Skill] Argus Close Technique, and had [Black Blade], a [B-level forbidden item], and [Silver Armor], a [C-level] defensive forbidden item.
He should have secretly manipulated Lynch's fate in the dark to make him die in an accident.
But he couldn't do it, not even his teacher could.
Although he is in the destiny sequence, he cannot affect the enemy's future.
Letting the extraordinary beings of the destiny sequence face to face with other extraordinary beings 1V1 is equivalent to asking the blind to drive, the mute to give speeches, the deaf to listen to music, and the lame to run errands...
Although Lamin is the Destiny Sequence: Sequence 5 Karma Thief, his frontal combat effectiveness is completely inferior to Lynch.
Lin Qi looked at Laming's embarrassed appearance and felt a little confused.
For what purpose had his teacher sent him?
If the opponent really knows him well, he must know that Lamin alone cannot defeat him at all.
Even though Lamin's sequence is one level higher than Kraft's, the two have completely different frontal fighting abilities.
One of them was trained as an assassination machine of the [Impermanent Secret Puppet Society] since childhood. After being tempered in various battles, he also learned a lot from Leon, a Sequence 3 man, in the later stage.
One of them is Lamin, who has very little combat experience, poor front-on fighting ability, and can only secretly write disgusting things in the dark...
Lynch didn't understand the other party's intention.
Master, what exactly do you do?
With your ability to fight head-on, you still dare to appear in front of me?
Chapter 399 [Lynch]
I'll knock you away with one elbow!
"What is your purpose? Kill me from the front?" Lin Qi, who couldn't figure it out, simply asked.Come, even as he asked, his gun was still pointed at Lamin.
Laming, who stood up, laughed angrily when he heard what Lynch said.
